limitations: shared-cloud finite workload, no queueing/venue latency
PMR byte counts exclude allocator overhead and non-PMR driver allocations
snapshot recovery limited to Phase 1 capacities
canonical artifacts are deterministic and reproducible from this code/seed; generated files remain outside Git
comparison control omits metadata and is not an optimization candidate

methodology.allocations: successful selected-PMR allocations/deallocations during bulk operation interval; setup excluded from deltas
methodology.copy: separate-TU by-value probes, IPO disabled; payload-only control is NOT semantically equivalent to full event
methodology.latency: separate serial operation-wrapper service-time pass; timer/error/checksum/lifecycle overhead included; no arrival queue
methodology.memory: PMR live-before/after and lifetime peak INCLUDING setup; process peak RSS includes inputs/oracle/sampling/driver
methodology.percentiles: nearest-rank over all raw per-operation samples
methodology.timer: raw paired-clock calibration reported; not subtracted
methodology.warmup: full untimed workload runs before each case
